rationale: All acceptance criteria are met. The limit is correctly raised to 20 across frontend (hook default, tooltip strings, test) and backend (two model validators, one endpoint guard). Three independent review lenses surfaced two defer-level concerns: (1) both model validators raise RequestValidationError inside @field_validator — technically non-standard Pydantic v2 (should be ValueError) but this is the established codebase pattern already in index.py and confirmed working by the edge-case lens; (2) VirtualAssistantChatRequest lacks the file_name back-compat model_validator, a pre-existing gap not introduced by this diff. Two additional minor defers: no router-level test for exactly-20-file success boundary; MAX_FILE_COUNT=20 duplicated across 3 sites. No blocking or critical findings.
follow_ups: Consider replacing RequestValidationError with ValueError in both @field_validator bodies for Pydantic v2 compliance — track alongside existing index.py pattern
Consider extracting MAX_FILE_COUNT=20 to a shared constant to eliminate three-site inconsistency risk
